title.description: Page title used in metadata and route navigation.
title.markdownDescription:
```yaml
title: About
```

The page title used in metadata and, by default, route navigation.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.15/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)

description.markdownDescription:
```yaml
description: About this project.
```

A concise page description used in metadata.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.15/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)

navigation.description: Optional navigation metadata for this page.

include.description: Include this page in site navigation. Pages are included when omitted.

label.description: Navigation label when it should differ from the page title.

navigation.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  include: true
  label: About us
```

Controls whether a route appears in site navigation and optionally replaces its visible title there. Homepage navigation is section-based.

[Route navigation reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.15/docs/routes.md#navigation)

sections.description: Optional metadata keyed by Markdown section id. Do not duplicate section order here.

visible.description: Optional date window for this section.

from.description: First date on which the content is visible.

until.description: First date on which the content is no longer visible.

additionalProperties.description: Metadata keyed by the explicit Markdown section id. Markdown order remains authoritative.

sections.markdownDescription:
```yaml
sections:
  announcement:
    visible:
      until: "2026-12-01"
```

Adds optional metadata keyed by explicit Markdown section id. Markdown headings remain the source of section content and order.

[Section metadata reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.15/docs/content.md#section-metadata)

description: Frontmatter for a homepage or route content.md file.
title: Norna page frontmatter
markdownDescription:
```yaml
---
title: About
description: About this project.
---
```

Every homepage and route `content.md` starts with page metadata, followed by Markdown sections.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.15/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)
